title: FF driving feel and handling
summary: This topic centers on front-wheel-drive character, with one clearly positive comment about confidence and many fragments that mention FF layout or feel without enough context for a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review says the FF setup feels close to 4WD and inspires confident driving.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments simply reference FF layout, handling, proportions, or driving feel without enough context to classify sentiment, and one fragment adds unrelated criticism about new technology.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or incomplete to determine sentiment reliably.
The cluster mixes direct comments about FF driving feel with at least one broader complaint about new technology, so it is not fully coherent.
Examples are stratified samples and do not represent the full population of reviews.
